checks.name: row count reconciles bronze -> silver
checks.sql: select abs((select count(*) from './data/raw/transactions_bronze.parquet') - (select count(*) from silver_transactions))

checks.name: every silver row has a status
checks.sql: select count(*) from silver_transactions where row_status is null

checks.name: fct_sales: quantity and price strictly positive
checks.sql: select count(*) from fct_sales where quantity <= 0 or unit_price <= 0

checks.name: fct_returns: only cancellation invoices
checks.sql: select count(*) from fct_returns where invoice_no not like 'C%'

checks.name: fct_orders: invoice_no unique
checks.sql: select count(*) - count(distinct invoice_no) from fct_orders

checks.name: dim_customer: key unique
checks.sql: select count(*) - count(distinct customer_key) from dim_customer

checks.name: dim_product: key unique
checks.sql: select count(*) - count(distinct product_key) from dim_product

checks.name: fct_sales -> dim_product referential integrity
checks.sql: select count(*) from fct_sales s anti join dim_product p on s.product_key = p.product_key

checks.name: fct_sales -> dim_customer referential integrity
checks.sql: select count(*) from fct_sales s anti join dim_customer c on s.customer_key = c.customer_key where s.customer_key is not null

checks.name: fct_sales -> dim_date referential integrity
checks.sql: select count(*) from fct_sales s anti join dim_date d on s.date_key = d.date_key

checks.name: revenue reconciles fct_sales = fct_orders
checks.sql: select (abs((select sum(line_revenue) from fct_sales) - (select sum(order_value) from fct_orders)) > 1)::int

checks.name: daily KPI has no calendar gaps
checks.sql: select (select count(*) from dim_date) - (select count(*) from mart_daily_kpis)

checks.name: cohort retention within [0, 1]
checks.sql: select count(*) from mart_cohort_retention where retention < 0 or retention > 1

checks.name: guest share of sale lines below 30%
no single day above 5x the median daily revenue
checks.sql: select count(*) from mart_daily_kpis where gross_revenue > 5 * (select median(gross_revenue) from mart_daily_kpis where orders > 0)
